inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, Jekyll config, recipe and component samples, recipe layout, search JSON template, and file counts

anchors.why: Defines Chowdown as a plaintext recipe database, explains Jekyll setup, recipe collection, frontmatter fields, and component recipes.
Declares recipes and components as output collections and defines translation labels for rendered sections.
Shows frontmatter with layout, title, image, tags, directions, and component references instead of ingredients.
Shows reusable sub-recipe component with ingredients, directions, image, and credit.
Renders schema.org Recipe microdata, ingredients, directions, component expansion, tags, images, and credits.
Generates title, ingredients, tags, image, URL, and description records for client-side search.

known_limits: Recipe content and tags are not VAKS evidence.
Component inclusion is useful composition but does not equal reviewed relation.
Client-side search JSON is an activation surface, not a truth layer.
